name: When should electrical sub-trade coordination begin during a construction project?

mainEntity.name: When should electrical sub-trade coordination begin during a construction project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Electrical sub-trade coordination should ideally begin during the design and pre-construction phases. Early involvement allows for comprehensive planning, identification of potential clashes, and integration of electrical requirements with architectural, structural, and mechanical designs. This proactive approach minimizes changes during actual construction, which can be expensive and time-consuming. City Dweller, LLC engages electrical sub-contractors early to review plans, provide input on constructability, and establish a coordinated schedule before ground is broken.
acceptedAnswer.description: Electrical sub-trade coordination should begin during the design and pre-construction phases to identify potential issues and integrate requirements early.
